properties.notes: Redevelop existing garages and private station car park to form a 3 storey courtyard apartment building of 41 flats, provide 12 mews flats and extend existing buildings to provide 18 flats (total 71). Re-provide station parking (total 141 spaces) including the change of use of land and the provision of hard surfacing, add 70 new residential spaces, 42 resident spaces, landscaping and ancillary works.
